sentences.要留意的是：舒服會削弱你前進的動力，有時你需要一點外來的推力。: The catch: comfort can sap your drive, and sometimes you need a push from outside.
sentences.天同的課題不在苦，在動力——舒服本身會削弱移動的理由。: For Tian Tong, the challenge isn't hardship but drive — comfort itself weakens the reasons to move.
sentences.有一點壓力，對你反而是好事。: A little pressure is actually good for you.
sentences.福氣厚，日子過得舒服，人緣寬，不必用力也有人願意幫。: You are well blessed: life is comfortable, you get on with people, and help arrives without your having to work for it.
sentences.它的舒服是真的，不必替它擔心。: That comfort is real; there's no need to worry about it.

sentences.它有一套自己認定的標準，而且相當堅持。: Tian Liang keeps its own standards, and holds to them firmly.
sentences.天同化忌，想安頓而安頓不下，舒服的條件恰好最缺。: Tian Tong turns to Obstruction: you want to settle but can't, and the very conditions for comfort are the ones in shortest supply.
sentences.它的形狀是拖而不是痛。: This shows up as drag rather than pain.
sentences.放假時你最懂得享受，一頓好飯、一個午覺就很滿足；只是舒服的位置坐久了，換工作、學: On holiday you know exactly how to enjoy yourself — a good meal and an afternoon nap are enough. But stay in a comfortable spot too long, and changing jobs or learning something new usually takes someone else's nudge.
